text:
anya: Quick mobile UX review — experimenting with bottom nav vs collapsed sidebar for the console on narrow widths. attaching mock: https://img.redwood.local/mock-mobile-console.png. Thoughts on gestures, persistent nav, and table overflow?

sam: Nice mock. I lean bottom nav — easier reach and matches common mobile patterns. Main question: where does 'Models' live? put it as a primary tab or under More? :thinking_face:

lee: Bottom nav makes sense but we must ensure persistence across deep routes (alerts -> model detail -> inference trace). Also careful with swipe gestures — could conflict with scroll/back.

lee: Technical note: if we do sticky bottom nav + horizontal table scroll, virtualization needs tweak to avoid layout jumps when rows rerender.

 tasha: Table overflow is messy today: we currently wrap columns and shove actions into a kebab on tiny screens which hides affordances. Prefer horizontal scroll with sticky first column, and a card fallback approach for <360px.

anya: Agree on horizontal scroll. Accessibility nits: keyboard users must be able to pan the table (arrow keys/overflow controls), focus outlines must be visible for table cells and actions, and all touch targets >= 44px.

sam: Copy tweak: in compact rows we show just `v1`. Can we show friendly name + version as two lines? e.g., `Llama-2\n v1` or `Llama-2 — v1` so it's scannable.

lee: Implementation idea: horizontal scroll + sticky first col. Use CSS like:```css
.table-wrapper { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.table .first-col { position: sticky; left: 0; background: var(--card-bg); }
```That plus modest overscan in virtualization should keep perf stable.

design-bot: Accessibility scan: sidebar icon contrast fails on dark theme (ratio 0.92:1). Recommend updating to #E6EEF8 or increase weight to meet 4.5:1 for body icon states.

 tasha: Gesture note: if we implement swipe left/right between primary tabs, do NOT override native Android back edge gesture. Also ensure we debounce swipe to avoid accidental tab changes during horizontal table scroll.

anya: Timeline? I'd like a prototype for user testing next week. Who can take the prototype + interaction spec?

lee: I can prototype the container + horizontal scroll + sticky col in Storybook by EOD Friday. Will need finalized spacing/touch targets from design.

sam: I'll draft acceptance criteria for the PR: 1) bottom nav appears <= 720px and persists across nested routes; 2) tables use horizontal scroll for widths >= 360px, card fallback < 360px; 3) touch targets >= 44px; 4) aria-labels on all interactive controls; 5) visual & accessibility regression checks pass.

tasha: :thumbsup: Also add a short note to release notes about the mobile console behavior change + guidance on keyboard nav.

anya: Thanks team — I'll update the mock with focus states and alt copy. ping @lee when ready and I'll run a quick 5-user hallway test next Tuesday.

sam: Will open a tracking issue and link the PR once prototype lands.

lee: One follow-up: do we animate the bottom nav appearing/disappearing on breakpoint cross? prefer a subtle fade to avoid layout jump.

anya: yes, subtle fade + reduced motion prefs respected. Also add a11y note: respect "prefers-reduced-motion" for nav transitions.

sam: Cool. I'll add that to acceptance criteria. Thanks all.
